title: WatchRateApprovedPayload
description: watch.rate.approved v1 (OpenVibe.Watch server/provider-rates.js decide(); plan P6, flag WATCH_PROVIDER_RATES off by default): a person approved a pending provider-rate change. The payload is the change (watch.rate.changed@1) plus the decision. It is EVIDENCE, not a billable rate: Watch writes no rate card, applied is always false, and OpenVibe.AI's catalog operator alone changes the supply rate card through AI's own path. Money is integer nano-USD per million tokens as a decimal string (D1: never a float). Envelope: subject { type: provider-rate, id: <source_key> }, visibility internal, priority important, source and actor service:watch; actor is the service, and decided_by names the person.

source_key.description: The source Watch fetched: the provider's key in its registry (deepinfra, featherless).

provider.description: The provider whose document stated the rate (deepinfra, featherless).

model.description: The model id exactly as the provider's document stated it.

from_nano_usd_per_m.description: The value Watch last observed, as an integer nano-USD per million tokens string; null for a first price.

to_nano_usd_per_m.description: The value the document stated, as an integer nano-USD per million tokens string.

currency.description: The document's currency; USD for both sources today.

region.description: The document's scope; global for both sources today.

effective_date.description: The first day this value was observed (YYYY-MM-DD).

decided_by.description: The person who approved it. A service or an agent may not; Watch refuses those with watch.rate_person_only.

applied.description: Always false: an approval is evidence and never writes a billable rate.
